checkpoints.prompt: Judge eligibility using the single supplied current observation. Earlier checkpoints are independent questions. For an ineligible record, decline with reason not_eligible, no quantity, no operands, no selected trials, and choose the one applicable finding: native_rate_unverified, declared_geometry_required or failed_signal_qc. A processed/interpolated record or disagreement among observed, declared and metadata native rates cannot enter the native method. Any required record-wide quality flag failure disqualifies the observation before computation. Return one JSON object with version m5.measurement-answer.v1, decision (compute or refuse), method, reason (eligible for a computation), selected_trials, citations, claims, quantity and operands. Use string arrays for selected_trials, citations and claims. Each operand has artifact, field, and numeric value. A computed quantity has numeric value and uncertainty, plus unit, dimension and estimand strings. When refusing, use null for quantity and empty arrays for operands and selected_trials. Cite DEV-005 and CX-003 in all decisions. DEV-005 describes method- and condition-specific GNSS/LPS results and distinguishes positional and Doppler observations. CX-003 documents acquisition and processing dependence of GNSS-derived external-load metrics. Use method lps-filter-sensitivity. For an eligible Z-up field record, report horizontal_positional_acceleration_filter_delta in m/s^2 (dimension acceleration) at row r as the horizontal acceleration norm from binomial-five smoothed positions minus the unfiltered norm. Use centered three-point differentiation twice for both estimators on the same admitted measurement grid. Binomial-five weights from earliest to latest are (1, 4, 6, 4, 1)/16, applied componentwise before differentiating. Report the sum of conservative fixed-grid radii 16e/h^2 and 1.25×16e/h^2, using horizontal_error_m for e and the minimum admitted reference step for h. This bounds the change in the contrast under deterministic position error balls. Use ordered raw operands: time, position_x and position_y each at rows r−4 through r+4 in channel order with keys like time.1, then horizontal_error_m. Select the current artifact name as the sole trial. Decide compute only with claims tag_horizontal_acceleration, filter_sensitivity_not_accuracy and fixed_grid_bound.

methods.sampling: Contiguous uniform native 25 Hz; nine-row support; fixed interior row; unfiltered and binomial5 position methods
methods.clock: Common exact measurement clock with zero latency
methods.geometry: Explicit Cartesian Z-up field frame and three synthetic non-collinear anchors
methods.qc: Production native admission, declared frame/anchors, timestamp-rate compatibility, integrity and per-anchor visibility
methods.eligibility: Synthetic native observation with intact channels and visibility throughout; row must support both centered derivative passes and filter
methods.uncertainty: Sum of conservative unfiltered and filtered horizontal acceleration radii under deterministic per-sample horizontal position error balls with fixed rows and exact timestamps
limitations: The signed filter contrast evaluates sensitivity of horizontal position-derived tag kinematics.
A response to smoothing gives no direction of correction, surveyed anchor validity, centre-of-mass acceleration or empirical instrument agreement.
